tests: with Export Verbose, every DONE line shows \ for each backslash of the path, and the files are right
steps:
1. A project with Export Verbose on (Project Settings, Export).
2. Export Project into an empty folder: the DEBUG CONSOLE shows each DONE line as [EXPORT]  DONE: \Sources\Startup.twin, \ for each backslash; the files are written right.
Control: the DELETED lines of a second verbose export, and the first and COMPLETED lines of an export without Export Verbose, show the backslashes.
